title: CodeSpend — budget alerts and spend visibility for coding agents
oneLiner: For developers and teams using AI coding agents, it tracks usage across Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and OpenAI APIs, provides per-project budgets with alerts, and attributes cost to tasks and branches to prevent surprise bills.
overlaps: pr-receipt — this focuses on PR-level token spend attribution; CodeSpend adds cross-tool budgeting, alerts, and project-level visibility
